page_title: VER 1-4 EMP | Verona v Empoli 08/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's the end of the match.
90+2' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Liam Henderson (Empoli) is given a yellow card.
90+2' Empoli take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Empoli have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

89' Luca Marianucci (Empoli) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Lorenzo Montipo makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the left side of the goal. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Empoli will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
87' The resulting set piece from Verona is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
86' Verona take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
85' Verona seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
83' Roberto D'Aversa prepares a substitution. Sebastiano Esposito is replaced by Ola Solbakken (Empoli).
82' Substitution. Luca Marianucci (Empoli) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Youssef Maleh walks off.
81' The rebound finds Daniel Mosquera (Verona) in space inside the box, but his shot flies high over the bar. That was a promising chance! The ball goes out of play and Empoli will have a goal kick.
80' We are about to witness a subsitution. Amin Sarr (Verona) for Casper Tengstedt.

78' Empoli slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
77' Daniel Mosquera (Verona) sends a cross into the box, but Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach comes off his line to gather the ball.
74' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Marco Di Bello had an easy-decision to make.
73' Total attempts – 10:12.

71' Good chance! Emmanuel Ekong (Empoli) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored! The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
69' Roberto D'Aversa has decided to make a change. Liam Henderson (Empoli) replaces Giuseppe Pezzella.
69' Substitution. Faustino Anjorin did his best and is replaced by Emmanuel Ekong (Empoli).
66' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
65' Daniel Mosquera (Verona) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Empoli will have a goal kick.
62' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and shoots towards goal, but it goes well wide of the right post.
60' Paolo Zanetti has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Grigoris Kastanos (Verona) replacing Dani Silva.
59' It is time for a substitution. Daniel Mosquera (Verona) is on for Tomas Suslov.
58' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) latches onto a lofted pass near the penalty spot only to head the ball yards wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Empoli.
56' The ball possession at the moment is 46:54.
53' Abdou Harroui (Verona) strikes a shot towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Empoli.

50' Poor effort! The corner picks out Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) completely unmarked in the centre of the box. He has time to pick his spot with the header but makes a mess of it, sending the ball well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
50' Empoli have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
49' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Empoli comes to nothing. Empoli have been awarded a corner kick.
48' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Good work from Empoli as they win a corner.
46' Paolo Zanetti makes a switch. Abdou Harroui (Verona) is coming on in place of Dailon Rocha Livramento at the start of the second period.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' Marco Di Bello has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY to Empoli, play can continue.
45+1' Referee Marco Di Bello makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Empoli. Let’s see what happens!
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Lorenzo Montipo (Verona) trips an opposition player and Marco Di Bello signals a foul. It's a penalty! Empoli have an opportunity to score from the penalty spot.

42' 1 - 4 Goal! Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom right corner. Lorenzo Montipo is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 1:4.
40' Daniele Ghilardi (Verona) has tested the patience of referee Marco Di Bello and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
39' Verona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

36' 1 - 3 Jackson Tchatchoua produces a sweet pass and picks out Casper Tengstedt (Verona) inside the box. He quickly takes a shot which goes into the bottom right corner and leaves the goalkeeper helpless. He makes it 1:3!
34' Paolo Zanetti decides to make a substitution. Domagoj Bradaric will be replaced by Daniele Ghilardi (Verona).
33' 0 - 3 Goal! Youssef Maleh plays it to Liberato Cacace (Empoli), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Lorenzo Montipo. 0:3.
32' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The ball has crossed the sideline. Empoli are taking a throw-in.
29' Tomas Suslov (Verona) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Marco Di Bello who sees an offensive foul.
27' Faustino Anjorin (Empoli) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
25' Faustino Anjorin (Empoli) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
22' Wonderful movement by Empoli. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.

19' 0 - 2 Goal! Faustino Anjorin plays in Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders and from inside the box slots it into the bottom right corner 0:2.
16' 0 - 1 Goal! Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) picks up the ball inside the box, finds himself in a good position and fires in a shot which is deflected past Lorenzo Montipo. He makes it 0:1.
15' Empoli failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
14' Relief for Dani Silva (Verona) as the ref sticks to his original yellow card decision after the VAR review.
13' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Dani Silva (Verona)! Let's see what he decides.
12' Dani Silva (Verona) makes an awful challenge on his opponent and can count himself very lucky that the referee didn't issue a red card.
11' Roberto D'Aversa is forced to make a change. Pietro Pellegri is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli).
10' Pietro Pellegri (Empoli) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
9' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
7' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Empoli.
6' The corner is swung in but Empoli can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. Corner kick. Empoli will have an opportunity.
5' An attempted cross from Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) is cleared.
4' Empoli take a short corner kick.
3' A pass by Dailon Rocha Livramento (Verona) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Empoli will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Marco Di Bello.
